title: Quarterly Rainfall Bulletin, Station K-12
key_sentences: This bulletin summarises the rainfall measured at Station K-12 during the third quarter of 2025.
The station is located on a hill farm about four kilometres north of Tarnby.
September was the wettest month of the quarter.
The next bulletin will be published in January 2026.

list_items.text: Values are rounded to the nearest millimetre.
A rain day is a day with at least 1 mm of rain.
Data for 14 August were estimated from a nearby station.

notes: Order on the page: h1, paragraph (2 sentences), paragraph containing a footnote reference, table with caption above it, lead-in line 'Notes for readers:', bulleted list (3 items), paragraph (1 sentence), and at the bottom of the page a footnote above-ruled in 9pt. The sentence carrying the footnote marker is NOT in key_sentences because its visible text has a superscript '1' between 'average' and the full stop: base text 'Total rainfall for the quarter was 214 millimetres, well above the long-term average.' with superscript '1' before the '.'. Footnote text (body, not furniture; superscript '1' then the sentence): 'The long-term average for the third quarter is 162 millimetres, based on the years 1991 to 2020.'. A good reader links the marker to the footnote; table rainfall values sum to 214.
